function: Excluded as above_phy: the only learned part is a GCN clique detector that selects the UE paths each AP serves (pp. 3, 10); beamforming, delays and power are analytical.
notes: Reason above_phy (user association). p. 3: 'Based on a given association strategy, the optimal asynchronous cooperative beamforming method is derived analytically'; the SSP-Set strategy is 'proposed to select serving user paths', using a GCN that 'uses the delay compensation as input and outputs the maximal clique probability'. p. 4: alpha_lkp says whether AP l serves UE k on path p. p. 6 and p. 10: precoders, delays and power come from closed forms, bisection and Algorithm 1, with no learned part. p. 10: the GCN only 'refines the initial feature' of delay compensation for maximal clique detection, replacing Bron-Kerbosch (p. 13). The GCN is auxiliary to an analytical design, so the reviewer may prefer no_learning, and the exclusion holds either way. Borderline case: if the reviewer reads the path selection as beam selection, the area would be 3 and the marks q1 0 (custom Saleh-Valenzuela channel, p. 3), q2 0 (K and N sweeps without stated training split, pp. 11-12), q3 0 (only classical Bron-Kerbosch compared, p. 13), q4 1 (O(K^2 P^2) and O(K^2 N) at the APs, p. 11), q5 0 (no release).
